title: Ovid2 mapper spec
description: Declarative mapper definition. One spec produces the mapped form of one CDM table for one pipeline. Loaded from pipelines/<pipeline>/mappers/<table>.yaml (or a Python-dict SPEC = {...} module).

v.description: Schema version. Bumped on breaking changes.

enabled.description: When false, the map stage skips this table for this pipeline.

ops.description: Ordered list of map ops. Ops are applied in the order listed.

class.description: Escape hatch — dotted path to a BaseMapper subclass. When set, `ops` MUST be empty. The engine hands off to the class instead of walking the op list.

op.description: Op name — must be registered in ovid2.mappers.registry.MAP_OPS.
